_readme: Fill in every empty url with a PUBLIC video you can open in an incognito window. Empty urls are reported as SKIPPED, never faked. Default mode is native (1 credit, no AI). Cases with mode auto/generate only run with --allow-generate.

cases.label: regular-captioned-en
cases.category: Regular video, existing captions (the example ID used in Supadata's own docs)

cases.label: regular-captioned-en-lang-es
cases.category: Language handling: request a language that may not exist; docs say it falls back to the first available language

cases.label: regular-captioned-non-english
cases.category: Regular video whose captions are NOT English (e.g. Hindi or Spanish)

cases.label: regular-multi-caption-tracks
cases.category: Video with several caption languages: check availableLangs, then re-run with lang set

cases.label: regular-no-captions-native
cases.category: Regular video with NO captions, native mode: expect HTTP 206 transcript-unavailable (1 credit)

cases.label: short-captioned-watch-form
cases.category: YouTube Short with captions, URL as youtube.com/shorts/ID (sent as canonical watch URL by default)

cases.label: short-captioned-as-given
cases.category: SAME Short as above. Run with --as-given to test whether the /shorts/ URL form works directly

cases.label: short-no-captions-native
cases.category: YouTube Short with no captions, native mode

cases.label: long-captioned-60min-plus
cases.category: Long video (60+ min) with existing captions, native only: checks payload size and latency

cases.label: private-or-unavailable
cases.category: A private, deleted or members-only video the user can identify

cases.label: nonexistent-id
cases.category: Well-formed but (almost certainly) nonexistent ID; if this returns a transcript, replace the ID

cases.label: ai-generate-short-clip
cases.category: AI transcription of a video UNDER 2 minutes with no captions (needs --allow-generate and YOUTUBE_API_KEY; costs about 2-4 credits)

cases.label: reject-non-youtube
cases.category: Local validation (no API call, no credits)

cases.label: reject-lookalike-host
cases.category: Local validation (no API call, no credits)

cases.label: reject-bad-video-id
cases.category: Local validation (no API call, no credits)

cases.label: reject-playlist-or-channel
cases.category: Local validation (no API call, no credits)

cases.label: reject-garbage
cases.category: Local validation (no API call, no credits)
